title: US jury in Luigi Mangione murder trial to remain anonymous
english: A New York judge has ruled that jurors in the murder trial of Luigi Mangione, who is accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, will remain anonymous. This rare decision is intended to protect jurors from potential harassment due to the high-profile nature of the case, which centers on frustration over healthcare industry practices. The trial is scheduled to begin in September, with prosecutors planning to present significant evidence, including surveillance footage and items recovered from the defendant.

Dhaddachi kun ji'a Fulbaanaa kan eegalu yoo ta'u, abbaan alangaa ragaalee fi qabxiiwwan gurguddoo shakkamaa sanaan walqabatan dhiheessuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Russia frees ex-US Marine Robert Gilman from detention
english: Russia has released former US Marine Robert Gilman after he spent four years in detention following a 2022 arrest. President Donald Trump confirmed his return and stated that his release was granted on humanitarian grounds without any prisoner swap. Although official reports suggest he is in stable condition, some lawmakers have expressed concern regarding his health and the alleged mistreatment he suffered while in custody.

oromo: Rusiyan qondaala waraana galaanaa duraanii kan turan Roobart Giilmaan waggaa afur hidhamanii booda gadhifteetti. Gabaasni mootummaa fayyaan isaanii gaarii ta'uu kan ibsu ta'us, hoggantoonni siyaasaa tokko tokko fayyaa isaanii fi dararaa inni hidha keessatti irra ga'e jedhame irratti yaaddoo qaban ibsaniiru.

title: Poland says Women’s World Cup plan on course despite UEFA boycott of FIFA
english: Poland confirmed that preparations for the upcoming FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup are on track despite a growing boycott threat from UEFA against FIFA. This tension follows a dispute over FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s controversial proposal to sell commercial rights to private investors. Several nations, including France and New Zealand, have already confirmed their participation in the tournament, which remains scheduled for September.

title: Israel and Venezuela renew diplomatic relations
english: Israel and Venezuela have officially restored diplomatic ties after a 17-year period of severed relations. Both nations have created a framework to manage consular services for their respective citizens. This development follows a recent shift in regional policy, coinciding with Colombia's decision to recognize Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights.

title: Saudi Arabia opposed Egypt's inclusion in Mecca agreement, sources say
english: Saudi Arabia recently blocked Egypt's participation in a new joint defense agreement formed with Turkey and Pakistan. Riyadh reportedly feels that Egypt no longer provides sufficient strategic or military value and is frustrated by Cairo's lack of support on key security matters. This decision reflects growing tensions between the two nations, fueled by Egypt's perceived unreliability and its close alignment with the United Arab Emirates.

title: UK Foreign Secretary Miliband calls for Israeli withdrawal from Gaza in first call with Saar
english: In his first conversation with Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar, UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband urged Israel to pull its military forces out of Gaza and stop the violence committed by settlers in the West Bank. Miliband also called for the immediate removal of obstacles preventing humanitarian aid from reaching Gaza and emphasized the necessity for Hamas to disarm. Furthermore, he reaffirmed the UK's support for a two-state solution and discussed the shared goal of preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons.

title: PSG vs Aston Villa: UEFA Super Cup – prediction, lineups, teams
english: Paris Saint-Germain and Aston Villa are set to compete for the UEFA Super Cup at the Salzburg Stadium in Austria this Wednesday. PSG enters the match aiming to defend their title, with the squad bolstered by stars like Ousmane Dembele and a recent reunion with defender Lucas Digne. The event marks the official start of the European football season shortly after the conclusion of the World Cup.

title: Trump faces lawsuit over push to limit birthright citizenship
english: President Donald Trump is facing a new lawsuit from various civil rights organizations after signing executive orders aimed at restricting birthright citizenship. The administration is attempting to redefine constitutional exceptions to limit automatic citizenship for children born to certain foreign nationals. These advocacy groups argue that the President's actions are unconstitutional and directly ignore a recent Supreme Court ruling that previously struck down similar efforts.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በተወለዱበት ሀገር ዜግነት የማግኘት መብትን ለመገደብ ባወጡት አዲስ አስፈፃሚ ትዕዛዝ ምክንያት የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ክስ መስርተውባቸዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በሕገ መንግስቱ ውስጥ ያሉትን ድንጋጌዎች በመተርጎም በተወሰኑ የውጭ ዜጎች ልጆች ላይ የሚሰጠውን ራስ-ሰር ዜግነት ለመቀነስ እየሞከረ ነው። ሆኖም ተሟጋች ቡድኖቹ ይህ የፕሬዝዳንቱ እርምጃ ከዚህ ቀደም ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ውድቅ ያደረገውን ህግ የሚጥስ እና ህገ-ወጥ ነው በማለት ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp mirga namoota biyya keessatti dhalatanitti lammummaa argachuuf qaban daangessuuf ajaja haarawa baasuun isaanii waldaalee mirga namoomaaf falman irraa himata irratti banameera. Bulchiinsi isaanii seera bu'uuraa biyyattii fayyadamuun ijoollee alagaa ta'anif lammummaa kennamu irratti daangaa kaa'uuf yaalaa jira. Gareewwan kunneen garuu, gochi pirezidaanticha kun seeraan ala fi murtee mana murtii olaanaa kanaan dura dabarfame kan faallessu ta'uu ibsuun mormaa jiru.

title: Death toll of Houthi attack on cargo ship rises to six: Yemeni coastguard
english: Houthi rebels carried out a deadly attack on a cargo ship near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, resulting in at least six deaths including Pakistani and Indonesian crew members. The rebels further escalated the violence by targeting a rescue team that was attempting to evacuate the vessel after the initial strike. Yemeni authorities report that this second assault caused additional casualties among the emergency responders.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ በጭነት መርከብ ላይ ባደረሱት ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የየመን የባህር ጠረፍ ጠባቂ አስታወቀ። በጥቃቱ ከሞቱት መካከል የፓኪስታን እና የኢንዶኔዥያ ዜጎች ይገኙበታል። በተጨማሪም ታጣቂዎቹ መርከቢቱን ለመታደግ በመጡ የነፍስ አድን ቡድን ላይ ሌላ ጥቃት በመሰንዘራቸው በነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ላይ ተጨማሪ ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Humni fincilaa Houthi qarqara galaana Bab el-Mandeb biratti doonii fe'umsaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen lubbuun namoota jahaa darbeera. Namoota du'an kunneen keessaa lammiileen Paakistaanii fi Indooneeshiyaa akka keessatti argaman ibsameera. Finciltoonni kun qulqulleeffattoota doonii sana gargaaruuf deeman irrattis haleellaa kan raawwatan yoo ta'u, kunis gargaartota sana irratti miidhaa dabalataa geessiseera.

title: Russia releases former US Marine reported in poor health
english: Russia has released Robert Gilman, a former US Marine who had been imprisoned since 2022 after an incident on a train. Gilman was freed for humanitarian reasons due to his declining health, which reportedly included a severe lung infection and a non-responsive medical condition. He is currently being transported back to the United States for urgent medical care.
amharic: ሩሲያ በ2022 በባቡር ላይ በተፈጠረ ግጭት ታስሮ የነበረውን የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ወታደር ሮበርት ጊልማንን ለቃለች። ጊልማን በከባድ የሳንባ ምች እና በሌሎች የጤና እክሎች በመታመሙ ምክንያት በሰብአዊ መብት አግባብ እንዲፈታ ተደርጓል። በአሁኑ ወቅት ህክምና ለማግኘት ወደ አሜሪካ እየተጓዘ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raashiyaan lammii Amerikaa fi miseensa waraana galaanaa kanaan duraa kan ture Robert Gilman, bara 2022 baabura keessatti hookkisa uumee ture jedhamee erga hidhee booda gadhiifteetti. Gilman dhibee sombaa hamaa fi dhukkuba ittiin wal-quunnachuu dadhabe jedhamuun wal-qabatee sababa namoomaatiin hidhaatii gadhiifame. Amma fayya isaa hordofuuf gara Amerikaatti ergameera.

title: Watch: Family escapes home during Colombia earthquake
english: A powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake recently struck Colombia, resulting in at least 169 deaths and the declaration of a state of emergency. A local family managed to escape their home safely just moments before the structure was severely impacted by the tremors. Officials have described this event as the most intense seismic activity recorded in the country during this century.
amharic: በቅርቡ በኮሎምቢያ የተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 169 ሰዎችን ሲገድል በአገሪቱ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ታውጇል። አንድ ቤተሰብ መንቀጥቀጡ ቤታቸውን ከመምታቱ ጥቂት ቀደም ብሎ በሰላም መውጣት ችለዋል። የኮሎምቢያ የጂኦሎጂካል አገልግሎት ይህ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በዚህ ክፍለ ዘመን በአገሪቱ ከታዩት ሁሉ እጅግ ከፍተኛው እንደሆነ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa keessatti dhohiinsa lafaa cimaa hamma 7.4 kan ta'e erga mudatee booda, namoonni 169 ol du'aniiru akkasumas haalli ariifachiisaan labsameera. Maatiin tokko manni isaanii osoo hin diigamin daqiiqaa muraasa dura nagaan bahuu danda'aniiru. Bulchiinsi biyyattii akka ibsetti, dhohiinsi lafaa kun jaarraa kana keessatti biyyattii keessatti kan mudate isa hunda caaluudha.

title: Hungary elects supreme court judge ousted by Orban as new president
english: The Hungarian parliament has elected Andras Baka, a former Supreme Court judge who was previously dismissed by Viktor Orban, as the country’s new president. Nominated by the Tisza party, Baka’s appointment serves as a symbolic move to dismantle the political structures established during Orban's tenure. While the presidency is largely ceremonial, his election signals a significant shift in Hungary's political landscape.
amharic: የሃንጋሪ ፓርላማ የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቪክቶር ኦርባን ከሥልጣን አባረውት የነበረውን የቀድሞ የጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ዳኛ አንድራስ ባካን የአገሪቱ አዲስ ፕሬዝዳንት አድርጎ መርጧል። በቲሳ ፓርቲ ዕጩነት የቀረቡት ባካ፣ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ የነበረውን የኦርባን የሥልጣን መዋቅር ለመቀየር የታቀደው የለውጥ አካል ናቸው። የፕሬዝዳንትነቱ ሚና በአብዛኛው ሥርዓታዊ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ምርጫ በሃንጋሪ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥ መኖሩን ያሳያል።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Hangari abbaa murtii mana murtii olaanaa kanaan dura Viktar Orbaaniin aangoo irraa ari’amee ture Andraas Baakaa pireezidaantii haaraa ta’ee filateera. Paartiin Tiizaa kan isa filachiise yoo ta’u, filannoon kun sirna siyaasaa Orbaan waggoota dheeraaf ijaare diiguuf tarkaanfii fakkeenya ta’uudha. Pireezidaantummaan Hangari aangoo raawwachiiftuu baay’ee kan hin qabne ta’us, filannoon kun jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa biyyattii keessatti mul’atu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Rwanda: The genocide against the Tutsi
english: The 1994 genocide in Rwanda was driven by historical divisions solidified during colonial rule and fueled by extremist propaganda. Extremists used media and political manipulation to organize rapid mass killings, while the international community failed to intervene. Today, the nation focuses on shaping its official memory through legal processes and memorials.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ1994 በሩዋንዳ የተፈጸመው የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀል የተከሰተው በቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን በተጠናከሩ የጎሳ ክፍፍሎች እና በአክራሪ ፕሮፓጋንዳዎች ምክንያት ነው። አክራሪ ቡድኖች መገናኛ ብዙኃንን በመጠቀም ህዝቡን ለጅምላ ጭፍጨፋ እንዲነሳሳ ያደረጉ ሲሆን ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብም ጣልቃ በመግባት ወንጀሉን ማቆም አልቻለም። በአሁኑ ወቅት ሩዋንዳ በህግ ሂደቶች እና በማስታወሻ ቦታዎች አማካኝነት የዘር ማጥፋቱን ታሪክ በይፋ በመዘከር ላይ ትገኛለች።
oromo: Ajjeechaan sanyii bara 1994 Ruwaandaatti raawwatame, gargar-ba'iinsa koloneeffattootaan jabeeffamee fi babal'ina duula jibbaa sirreessitootaan kan uumame dha. Gareewwan daandii qabatanii jiran miidiyaa fayyadamuun ummata wal-fixiinsaaf kakaasanii turan; haata'u malee hawaasni addunyaa dhimma kana dhaabsisuu dadhabeera. Yeroo ammaa Ruwaandaan seenaa kana seeraa fi bakka yaadannoo garaagaraan yaadachuun of-ijaaraa jirti.

title: Lebanon parliament votes to end death penalty, 1st in Middle East to do so
english: Lebanon has officially become the first Middle Eastern nation to abolish the death penalty, replacing capital punishment with life imprisonment involving hard labor. While the country had not carried out an execution since 2004, this new law codifies the end of the practice, a move human rights organizations have hailed as a significant victory. The legislation passed with majority support despite some uncertainty regarding how the new labor requirements will be implemented.
amharic: ሊባኖስ የሞት ቅጣትን ሙሉ በሙሉ በመሻር በምስራቅ መካከለኛው ክፍል ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደች የመጀመሪያዋ ሀገር ሆናለች። ከዚህ በኋላ የሞት ቅጣት በምትክ በከባድ የጉልበት ስራ የታጀበ የእድሜ ልክ እስራት ይሆናል። ምንም እንኳን ሀገሪቱ ከ2004 ጀምሮ ግድያ ባትፈጽምም፣ አዲሱ ህግ የሞት ቅጣትን በይፋ በማስቀረት የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶችን አድናቆት አትርፏል።
oromo: Libanoon adabbii du'aa guutummaatti haquun biyya jalqabaa naannawa Baha Giddu-galeessaa taateetti. Adabbiin du'aa kun fuulduratti hidhaa cimaa fi hojii humnaa of keessatti qabatuun bakka bu'a. Biyyi kun bara 2004 irraa jalqabee namni tokkollee akka hin ajjeefamne kan turte ta'us, seera haaraan kun mirga namoomaa kabachiisuuf tarkaanfii guddaa akka ta'e dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa ibsaniiru.

title: DC residents debate safety gains a year into Trump’s Guard deployment
english: It has been one year since President Trump deployed the National Guard to Washington, DC, to combat local crime through his 'Safe and Beautiful Task Force.' Residents and officials remain deeply divided, with many locals criticizing the presence as a military occupation that fails to address root social issues. While legal challenges regarding the constitutionality of using troops for local policing are ongoing in court, the administration continues to maintain the deployment.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ የነገሰውን የወንጀል ችግር ለመቅረፍ የብሔራዊ ጥበቃ ሰራዊትን ካሰማሩ አንድ ዓመት ሆኗል። የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎችና ባለስልጣናት በሰራዊቱ ቆይታ ላይ ያላቸው አመለካከት የተለያየ ሲሆን፣ ብዙዎች ይህ እርምጃ መሰረታዊ የማህበራዊ ችግሮችን ከመፍታት ይልቅ ወታደራዊ ወረራን የሚያስታውስ ነው ሲሉ ይተቻሉ። ወታደሮችን ለሀገር ውስጥ የፖሊስ ስራ ማዋል ህገ-መንግስታዊ ይሁን አይሁን የሚለው ክርክር በፍርድ ቤት እየታየ ቢሆንም፣ አስተዳደሩ ሰራዊቱን በቦታው ማስቆየቱን ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp magaalaa Waashingitan Diisii keessatti yakka ittisuuf waraana 'National Guard' erguun waggaa tokko guuteera. Jiraattoonni fi hoggantoonni magaalatittii dhimma kana irratti yaada gara garaa kan qaban yoo ta'u, baay'een isaanii waraanni kun rakkoo hawaasummaa furuu mannaa, akka duula waraanaatti waan ilaallamuuf mormii qabu. Itti fayyadama waraanaa kana ilaalchisee mormiin seeraa fi kutaaleen bulchiinsaa gara garaa jiranis, mootummaan hanga ammaatti waraana kana magaalatittii keessatti tursee jira.

title: Total solar eclipse 2026: Where, when and how to watch on Wednesday?
english: On Wednesday, a rare total solar eclipse will travel from the Arctic across parts of Europe, offering millions of people a brief period of total darkness. While countries like Spain, Iceland, and Greenland will experience the full eclipse, many other regions in North America and Europe will see a partial covering of the sun. It is the first event of this kind in 27 years, and experts advise viewers to use proper safety equipment to watch the phenomenon.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በሰሜን ዋልታ በኩል ተነስቶ ወደ አውሮፓ የሚያመራ ብርቅዬ የሆነ ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ይከሰታል። ስፔን፣ አይስላንድ እና ግሪንላንድን ጨምሮ በተወሰኑ አካባቢዎች ሙሉ ለሙሉ ጨለማ የሚፈጠር ሲሆን፣ በሰሜን አሜሪካ እና በአውሮፓ ክፍሎች ደግሞ የፀሐይ ግርዶሹ በከፊል ይታያል። ይህ በ27 ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የታየው ክስተት ሲሆን፣ ተመልካቾች በደህና ሁኔታ ለመመልከት ትክክለኛ የመከላከያ መሳሪያዎችን እንዲጠቀሙ ይመከራል።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii kana guutuu biyya lafaa keessatti bakka bu'iinsi aduu cimaan kan mul'atu yoo ta'u, kunis Arktiik irraa ka'ee hanga Awurooppaatti bal'inaan kan mul'atu dha. Biyyoonni akka Ispeen, Ayslaandi fi Giriinlaandi guutummaatti dukkana kan ta'an yoo ta'u, Kaanaadaa fi kutaan Awurooppaa kan biroo immoo aduun garaa garatti akka haguugamtu arguu danda'u. Kun waggaa 27 keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf kan mul'atu yoo ta'u, namoonni fayyummaa isaanii eeggachuuf meeshaalee dhorkaa addaa fayyadamuu akka qaban gorfameera.

title: Qatar attacks Israeli 'foot-dragging' over Gaza deal
english: Qatar has officially criticized Israel for delaying the implementation of a US-backed peace proposal for Gaza. While Hamas has expressed willingness to follow the agreement, Israeli leadership continues to reject the plan. Despite this public disagreement, the United States maintains that the ceasefire deal is still active.
amharic: ኳታር በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም ስምምነት እስራኤል ለማዘግየት እየሞከረች እንደሆነ በይፋ ከሳለች። ሀማስ ስምምነቱን ለመቀበል ፍቃደኛ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ የእስራኤል መንግስት ግን እቅዱን ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን በእስራኤል በኩል ተቃውሞ ቢኖርም፣ አሜሪካ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ አሁንም በስራ ላይ እንዳለ አሳውቃለች።
oromo: Qatar mootummaan Israa'el karoorri nagaa Gaazaaf bahe akka hin raawwatamne harkisaa akka jiru komatteetti. Hamas walii galtee sana kabajuuf fedhii qabaatus, Israa'el garuu karoora kana fudhachuu dideetti. Garaagarummaan kun jiraatus, mootummaan Ameerikaa walii galteen dhaabbii waraanaa kun ammayyuu hojiirra akka jiru ibseera.

title: Exclusive: ICC issued two secret arrest warrants for Taliban members for gender persecution
english: The International Criminal Court has issued two previously undisclosed arrest warrants for senior Taliban officials accused of gender and political persecution. These secret warrants build upon previous public charges against Taliban leadership by introducing new evidence and additional victims, including the first international legal recognition of LGBTQ+ individuals. Court officials kept these warrants confidential to avoid potential political retaliation and sanctions from the United States.
amharic: ዓለም አቀፉ የወንጀለኞች ፍርድ ቤት በጾታ እና በፖለቲካዊ አመለካከት ጭቆና ፈጽመዋል በሚል በሁለት ከፍተኛ የታሊባን ባለስልጣናት ላይ ምስጢራዊ የእስር ማዘዣ አውጥቷል። እነዚህ ምስጢራዊ የእስር ማዘዣዎች አዳዲስ ማስረጃዎችን እና ተጎጂዎችን የሚያካትቱ ሲሆን፣ የኤልጂቢቲኪው (LGBTQ+) ግለሰቦችን በዓለም አቀፍ ህግ ተጎጂ አድርጎ የለየ የመጀመሪያው ክስተት ነው። የፍርድ ቤቱ ባለስልጣናት ከአሜሪካ ሊመጣ የሚችለውን ጫና እና ማዕቀብ ለመሸሽ ማዘዣዎቹን ምስጢራዊ ለማድረግ ወስነዋል።
oromo: Mana Murtii Yakka Ardii Addunyaa (ICC) hoogganoota garee Taalibaan irratti himata gidiraa saala fi siyaasaa irratti hundaa'e kanaan walqabatee ajaja hidhaa icciitii ta'e lama baaseera. Ajajni hidhaa kun ragaa haaraa fi miidhamtoota dabalataa kan qabatu yoo ta'u, seenaa keessatti yeroo jalqabaaf namoonni LGBTQ+ akka miidhamtootaatti seera idil-addunyaatiin akka beekaman taasiseera. Hoggantoonni mana murtichaa ajaja kana icciitiin kan qaban mootummaa Amerikaa irraa tarkaanfii fi san'iinii (adabbii) nurra gahuu danda'a jedhanii waan sodataniifidha.

title: Inside the growing rift between Iran’s dealmakers and ultraconservatives
english: A significant political divide is deepening in Iran between reformists seeking a deal with the U.S. and hardline factions determined to prevent it. Opponents of the current administration are working to undermine President Pezeshkian and his diplomatic team to maintain their own political influence. Recent leaked remarks suggest that the leadership is putting intense pressure on the president to discourage his resignation threats while sidelining key diplomats involved in negotiations.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ስምምነት እንዲኖር የሚፈልጉት እና ይህንን ለመቃወም የሚጥሩት ወገኖች በኢራን የፖለቲካ መድረክ ላይ ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ፈጥረዋል። በስልጣን ላይ ያሉትን መሪዎች ተፅዕኖ ለመቀነስ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ጠንካራ ወገኖች ፕሬዝዳንት ፔዜሽኪያንን እና የዲፕሎማቲክ ቡድናቸውን ለማዳከም እየሰሩ ነው። የቅርብ ጊዜ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት የአገሪቱ አመራር ፕሬዝዳንቱ ስልጣን ለመልቀቅ የሚያደርጉትን ማስፈራሪያ እንዲያቆሙ ከፍተኛ ግፊት እያደረጉባቸው ሲሆን፣ በድርድሩ ላይ የተሳተፉ ዲፕሎማቶችንም ከስራ በማግለል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Iraan keessatti gareen araara Ameerikaa waliin fedhanifi gareen mormitoota cimaa ta'an gidduutti wal dhabdeen siyaasaa guddachaa jira. Gareen sadarkaa ol aanaa irratti argaman kun dhiibbaa uumuun pirezidant Pizeeshkiyaanii fi garee isaa laaffisuun aangoosaanii tikfachuuf carraaqaa jiru. Odeeffannoon haaraa ba'e akka agarsiisutti, hoggansii biyyattii pirezidantichi lakkisuuf sodaachisuu akka dhaaban dhiibbaa cimaa gochaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, dippilomatoota marii keessatti qooda fudhatanis hojiirraa gaggeessaa jiru.

title: Palestinian medics in Israel face incitement over unproven patient abuse claims
english: Israeli government ministers are calling for an investigation into unproven claims that Arab medical workers at Rambam Hospital mistreated a wounded soldier. The High Follow-Up Committee for Arab Citizens of Israel has denounced these accusations, labeling them an incitement campaign against Palestinian healthcare staff. While the hospital has officially denied the allegations, many medical professionals fear these baseless claims are damaging the reputation of all Arab staff in the country.
amharic: የእስራኤል መንግሥት ሚኒስትሮች በራምባም ሆስፒታል የሚሰሩ አረብ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች የተጎዳ ወታደርን በደል ፈጽመውባቸዋል በሚል ያልተረጋገጠ ክስ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው። የእስራኤል አረብ ዜጎች ከፍተኛ ኮሚቴ ይህንን ክስ በአረብ የህክምና ሰራተኞች ላይ የሚደረግ የጥላቻ ቅስቀሳ ነው ሲል አውግዞታል። ሆስፒታሉ ክሱ ሀሰት መሆኑን በይፋ ቢገልጽም፣ ብዙ የህክምና ባለሙያዎች ይህ መሰረተ ቢስ ውንጀላ በአረብ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ላይ መጥፎ ገጽታ እየፈጠረ ነው በማለት ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni mootummaa Israa'el hojjettoota yaala fayyaa Arabaa hospitaala Rambam keessa hojjetanirratti waraana miidhame dararuu isaanii himatan irratti qorannoon akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru. Koreen ol'aanaan lammiilee Israa'el kanneen Arabaa himannaa kana duula jibbinsaa kan hojjettoota fayyaa irratti xiyyeeffate jedhee balaaleffateera. Hospitaalichi himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, ogeeyyiin fayyaa hedduun himannaan ragaa hin qabne kun hojjettoota fayyaa Arabaa hunda irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jira jedhanii yaadda'u.

title: Saudi defence pact with Turkey and Pakistan sparks UAE backlash
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan recently signed the 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement,' which treats an attack on one member as an attack on all three. This move has caused tension with the United Arab Emirates, as some Emirati officials fear it undermines the unity of the Gulf Cooperation Council. In response, Saudi figures have defended the agreement as an exercise of national sovereignty and their right to pursue independent security interests.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን አዲስ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት መፈራረማቸውን ተከትሎ በሳውዲ እና በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች መካከል አለመግባባት ተፈጥሯል። ይህ ስምምነት በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ እንዲቆጠር የሚያደርግ በመሆኑ፣ አንዳንድ የኤሚሬቶች ባለስልጣናት የባህረ ሰላጤው የትብብር ምክር ቤት አንድነት ይጎዳል በሚል ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው፣ ሀገራቸው የራሷን የደህንነት ፍላጎቶች ለመወሰን ሙሉ መብት እንዳላት በመግለጽ ስምምነቱን ተከላክለዋል።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaa, Turkeenii fi Paakistaan waligaltee ittisaa haaraa kan walii-wajjin mallatteessan yoo ta'u, kunis jidduu Saudii Arabiyaa fi Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomanii (UAE) tti mormii uumeera. Waligalteen kun, miidhaan tokko irratti gahu akka miidhaa hunda irratti gahee ilaalutti kan hidhu yoo ta'u, angawoonni UAE tokkummaan waggaa dheeraa GCC keessa ture akka miidhamu sodaatu. Gama biraatiin, angawoonni Saudii Arabiyaa waligalteen kun mirga biyyattii kan ofiin murteeffachuu ta'uu fi fedhii nageenyaa ishee eegsisuuf kan barbaachisu ta'uu ibsuun falmaniiru.

title: Luigi Mangione back in court as key questions remain over case ahead of murder trial
english: Luigi Mangione has returned to court in New York for preliminary proceedings before his murder trial for the death of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson begins on September 8. While a judge has ruled that key evidence, including a weapon and a notebook, will be admissible, several questions regarding the defense's strategy remain unresolved. The case has sparked significant public debate, with supporters viewing the accused as a figure of protest against healthcare costs, while he continues to maintain his innocence.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ሄልዝኬር ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ብሪያን ቶምፕሰንን ገድለዋል በሚል የተከሰሱት ሉዊጂ ማንጊዮን ለስድስተኛው ወር የሙከራ ሂደት በኒውዮርክ ፍርድ ቤት ቀርበዋል። ዳኛው ዋና ዋና ማስረጃዎች ማለትም የጦር መሳሪያው እና የማስታወሻ ደብተሩ ለፍርድ ሂደቱ ተቀባይነት እንደሚኖራቸው የወሰኑ ሲሆን፣ የተከሳሹ የጠበቃ ቡድን ስትራቴጂ ግን እስካሁን በግልፅ አልታወቀም። ጉዳዩ በህክምና አገልግሎት ዋጋ ላይ ያተኮረ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ትኩረት የሳበ ቢሆንም፣ ተከሳሹ የቀረቡበትን ክሶች በሙሉ አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Luigi Mangione namicha ajjeechaa hoji geggeessaa dhaabbata UnitedHealthcare Brian Thompson raawwate jedhamee himatame, guyyaa guraandhala 8 qorumsa mana murtiitiif dura sadarkaa duraa irratti argameera. Manni murtii ragaalee ijoo ta'an kan akka qawwee fi kitaaba barreessaa isaa akka dhiyaatan kan murteesse ta'us, tarsiimoon ittisaa himatamichaa hanga ammaatti ifa miti. Dhimmi kun gatii tajaajila fayyaa irratti mormii uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, Mangione yakka isarratti dhiyaate hunda ni haala.

title: War on Iran: Mojtaba Khamenei is in ‘perfect health’, Iran says
english: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has officially confirmed that Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is in excellent health. This statement follows a recent reorganization of Iran's military leadership. Meanwhile, both Tehran and Washington remain locked in a dispute, with both sides seeking compensation related to the ongoing war.
amharic: የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማሱድ ፔዜሽኪያን የበላይ መሪው ሞጅታባ ካሜኒ በጥሩ ጤንነት ላይ እንደሚገኙ በይፋ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው በኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራር ውስጥ ከተደረገው የቅርብ ጊዜ የአደረጃጀት ለውጥ በኋላ ነው። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን እና አሜሪካ በጦርነቱ ምክንያት ለሚደርሰው ጉዳት ካሳ እንዲከፈላቸው በመጠየቅ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan, hoogganaan olaanaa Mojtaabaa Kaameeneen fayyaa gaarii irratti akka argaman ifa godhaniiru. Ibsi kun kan kenname yeroo hooggansa waraana Iraan keessatti jijjiiramni cimaan gaggeeffamaa jiruutti. Gama biraatiin, Iraan fi Waashingitan waraanicha waliin walqabatee kaffaltii beenyaa wal gaafachaa jiru.

title: ‘Only job I know’: Philippine sailors return to sea despite wartime risks
english: Many Filipino sailors are choosing to return to work on cargo ships despite facing significant dangers in conflict zones like the Strait of Hormuz and the Black Sea. Although they have personally experienced missile strikes and life-threatening conditions, these workers continue to accept these assignments to support their families. For many, maritime employment remains the primary way to secure financial stability and provide a better life for their loved ones back home.
amharic: በርካታ የፊሊፒንስ መርከበኞች እንደ ሆርሙዝ ስትሬት እና ጥቁር ባሕር ባሉ አደገኛ የጦርነት ቀጠናዎች ውስጥ ቢሆንም ወደ ሥራቸው ለመመለስ እየተጣደፉ ነው። እነዚህ ሠራተኞች ቀደም ሲል ሚሳይል ጥቃቶችን እና ለሕይወት አስጊ የሆኑ ሁኔታዎችን ቢያስተናግዱም፣ ለቤተሰቦቻቸው መተዳደሪያ ሲሉ አደጋውን ለመጋፈጥ ይገደዳሉ። ለብዙዎቹ የባሕር ላይ ሥራ ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ለመደገፍ እና የተሻለ የኑሮ ሁኔታ ለመፍጠር ብቸኛው አማራጭ ሆኗል።
oromo: Garee humna galaana warra Filippiinii hedduun naannoowwan waraana cimaa keessa jiran kan akka Hormuuzii fi Galaana Gurraachaatti illee hojiitti deebi'uuf dirqamaa jiru. Hojjettoonni kun yeroo darbe rukuttaa mishaayilaa fi balaa lubbuu qabu keessa darbanis, maatii isaanii gargaaruuf jecha riskii kana fudhachuuf dirqamu. Hojjettoota baay'eef, hojiin galaana irraa kun qabeenya argachuu fi jireenya maatii isaanii fooyyessuuf karaa isaanii inni jalqabaa ta'ee itti fufeera.

title: What are Saudi Arabia, Turkiye and Pakistan’s joint military capabilities?
english: Saudi Arabia, Turkiye, and Pakistan have established the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement, a new pact where an attack on one nation is considered an attack on all three. By combining their military assets, the bloc forms a powerful force consisting of 1.4 million personnel, extensive naval fleets, and thousands of tanks and aircraft. The partnership aims to enhance regional security by leveraging Saudi Arabia's financial resources, Turkiye's advanced military technology, and Pakistan's significant manpower and nuclear capabilities.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ ቱርክ እና ፓኪስታን በመካ የተፈረመ የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ያቋቋሙ ሲሆን፣ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሦስቱም ላይ እንደተፈጸመ ይቆጠራል። እነዚህ አገራት ጥምረት በመፍጠር 1.4 ሚሊዮን ወታደሮችን፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ታንኮችን እና የጦር አውሮፕላኖችን እንዲሁም ሰፊ የባህር ኃይል አቅም የያዘ ኃይለኛ ወታደራዊ ቡድን መስርተዋል። ይህ ስምምነት የሳውዲን የገንዘብ አቅም፣ የቱርክን የላቀ ወታደራዊ ቴክኖሎጂ እና የፓኪስታንን የሰው ኃይልና የኑክሌር አቅም በማቀናጀት ቀጠናዊ ደህንነትን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan, Turkiyii fi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaa kan 'Mecca' jedhamu kan mallatteessan yoo ta'u, biyyoota sadan kana keessaa irratti weerarri tokko yoo raawwatame akka irratti hunda irratti raawwatametti ilaalama. Dandeettii waraanaa isaanii walitti makuun, humna cimaa kan waraana miliyoona 1.4, taankiiwwanii fi xiyyaarota kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman, akkasumas humna galaanaas qabu uumaniiru. Walii-galteen kun qabeenya maallaqaa Saudii Arabiyaa, teeknoolojii waraanaa Turkiyii fi humna namaa akkasumas dandeettii niwukilaaraa Paakistaan walitti fiddee nageenya naannichaa cimsuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Under Fire: Lebanon’s first responders | Al Jazeera Originals
english: The documentary 'Under Fire' highlights the dangerous work of Lebanese first responders who continue to provide emergency services amidst ongoing Israeli military strikes. It focuses on Ali Safiuddin and his Civil Defense team as they risk their lives to rescue survivors and evacuate the injured in southern Lebanon. The film explores the profound emotional toll and the personal sacrifices these heroes endure while serving their communities in a war zone.
amharic: የአልጀዚራው 'አንደር ፋየር' ዘጋቢ ፊልም በእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶች መካከል ሆነው አደጋዎችን በመቀነስ ህይወት ለማዳን የሚታገሉትን የሊባኖስ የመጀመሪያ ምላሽ ሰጪዎች ያሳያል። በተለይም አሊ ሳፊኡዲን እና የሲቪል መከላከያ ቡድኑ በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በጦርነት ውስጥ ሆነው የቆሰሉ ሰዎችን ለመታደግ የሚከፍሉትን መስዋዕትነት ይዳስሳል። ፊልሙ እነዚህ ሰዎች በስራቸው የሚያጋጥማቸውን ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ጫና እና የህይወት ፈተናዎች በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'Under Fire' jedhu namoota gargaarsa ariifachiisaa Libanon keessatti kennan, kanneen haleellaa waraanaa gidduutti lubbuu baraaruuf dhama'an irratti xiyyeeffata. Ali Safiuddin fi gareen isaa kan itti gaafatamummaa Civil Defense fudhatan, naannoo kibba Libanon keessatti balaa jiru osoo hin sodaatin madaa'ota gargaaruuf carraaqqii guddaa gochaa jiru. Fiilmichi rakkoo sammuu fi wareegama namoonni kun uummata isaaniif jecha kaffalan ifatti baasa.

title: Liverpool fans seek clarity on Bezos bid to buy stake
english: Liverpool supporters are demanding a formal meeting with the club's management following reports that a consortium including Amazon founder Jeff Bezos is nearing a deal to purchase a significant minority stake. The fan group Spirit of Shankly expressed concerns about how this potential change in ownership might impact the club's operations and values. Fenway Sports Group has acknowledged receiving interest from the investment group, which also reportedly includes Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin.
amharic: የሊቨርፑል ደጋፊዎች የአማዞን መስራች ጄፍ ቤዞስን ጨምሮ አንዳንድ ባለሀብቶች የክለቡን የድርሻ ድርሻ ለመግዛት እየተደራደሩ ነው በሚል የሚነገሩ ዘገባዎችን ተከትሎ ግልጽ መረጃ እንዲሰጣቸው ጠይቀዋል። የደጋፊዎች ቡድኑ የክለቡ አስተዳደር ይህ ሽያጭ በክለቡ አሠራር እና እሴቶች ላይ የሚያመጣውን ለውጥ እንዲያብራራላቸው አሳስቧል። የሊቨርፑል ባለቤት የሆነው ፌንዌይ ስፖርት ግሩፕ ከባለሀብቶቹ የቀረበለትን ጥያቄ እንደተቀበለ አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Deeggartoonni Liverpool gareen invastimantii kan keessaatti abbaan qabeenyaa Amazon Jeff Bezos argaman, qooda garee kanaa bituuf mari'achaa jiru jedhamee gabaasame irratti ibsa gaafatanii jiru. Gareen deeggartoota 'Spirit of Shankly' jedhamu, jijjiiramni abbummaa kun hojii fi duudhaa garee kana irratti dhiibbaa akkamii akka qabaatu beekuuf walga'ii gaafataniiru. Abbaan qabeenyaa Liverpool, Fenway Sports Group, gareen invastimantii kun fedhii qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneesseera.

title: What’s behind Iran’s new military appointments and what do they indicate?
english: Iran’s Supreme Leader has appointed six veteran commanders to key military and security roles to strengthen the nation's wartime leadership. Analysts suggest these appointments prioritize loyalty and experience, aiming to consolidate authority and address vulnerabilities exposed during recent conflicts. By placing trusted hardliners in charge of the IRGC and other forces, the leadership intends to improve military readiness and response capabilities for future crises.
amharic: የኢራን የበላይ መሪ በጦርነት ጊዜ ያለውን የሀገሪቱን መከላከያ እና የጸጥታ መዋቅር ለማጠናከር ስድስት ልምድ ያላቸው አዛዦችን በከፍተኛ የኃላፊነት ቦታዎች ላይ ሾመዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት፣ እነዚህ ሹመቶች ለታማኝነት እና ለልምድ ቅድሚያ በመስጠት፣ በቅርብ ጊዜ በተከሰቱ ግጭቶች ወቅት የታዩ የደህንነት ክፍተቶችን ለመሙላት የታለሙ ናቸው። ታማኝ አርበኞችን በኃላፊነት ላይ በማስቀመጥ፣ የኢራን አመራር ለቀጣይ ቀውሶች የሚኖረውን የጦር ዝግጁነት እና የመከላከል አቅም ለማሳደግ እያቀደ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran qondaaltota waraanaa durii ja'a bakka iddoo olaanaatti muudaniiru; kunis haala waraana keessatti biyyattii jabeessee itti fufsiisuuf kan gargaaruudha. Akka xiinxaltootni jedhanitti, muudamni kun amanamummaa fi muuxannoo irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, rakkoo waraana darbe keessatti mul'atan sirreessuuf kan kaayyeeffatedha. Qondaaltota amanamoo ta'an kanneen sadarkaa olaanaatti ramaduun, mootummaan Iran qophii waraana isaa fi dandeettii rakkoo gara fuulduraatti mudachuu danda'u ofirraa ittisuu cimsachuu barbaada.

title: Hunter Biden defends Tucker Carlson over Netanyahu comments
english: Hunter Biden has spoken out in support of journalist Tucker Carlson following accusations of anti-Semitism. The controversy stems from Carlson labeling Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu as 'evil incarnate.' Hunter Biden expressed disagreement with the idea that such a political criticism should be categorized as hatred toward Jewish people.
amharic: ሃንተር ባይደን በጋዜጠኛው ታከር ካርልሰን ላይ የቀረበውን የፀረ-ሴማዊነት ክስ በመቃወም ድጋፉን ሰጥቷል። ክሱ የተነሳው ካርልሰን የእስራኤሉን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ 'የክፋት ተምሳሌት' በማለታቸው ነው። ሃንተር ባይደን ይህ ዓይነቱ የፖለቲካ ትችት እንደ ፀረ-ሴማዊነት መቆጠር የለበትም ሲል ተከራክሯል።
oromo: Hanter Baayiden himata jibba Yihuudii ilaalchisee gaazexeessaa Taakar Kaarlisan akka deggeru ibseera. Kaarlisan muummicha ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Netanyaahuu 'hammeenya qulqulluu' jechuudhaan waamuu isaa hordofee falmii kana keessa seeneera. Hanter Baayiden, qeeqni siyaasaa akkanaa jibba sanyii irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu qaba jedhanii amanuun sirrii miti jechuun yaada isaa ibseera.

title: Final phase of voting in Pakistan-administered Kashmir, despite security fe
english: The final stage of elections for the Legislative Assembly in Pakistan-administered Kashmir has concluded. Although voting was scheduled for 11 constituencies, the process was limited to only four areas due to ongoing instability. Security concerns hindered the full implementation of the vote across the region.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት የመጨረሻው የምርጫ ሂደት ተካሂዷል። ምንም እንኳን ምርጫው በ11 የምርጫ ክልሎች እንዲከናወን ታቅዶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ በክልሉ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ድምጽ መስጠት የተቻለው በአራት ክልሎች ብቻ ነው። የፀጥታ ስጋቶች ምርጫው በተሟላ ሁኔታ እንዳይካሄድ እንቅፋት ሆነዋል።
oromo: Hirmaannaan filannoo mana maree seera baastuu bulchiinsa Paakistaan jala jiru Kaashmiir keessatti xumurameera. Filannoon kun bakka 11 keessatti kan karoorfame ta'us, naannichatti rakkoo nageenyaa mudateen kanneen keessaa bakka afur qofa keessatti sagaleen kennameera. Sodaan nageenyaa filannoon kun guutummaatti akka hin gaggeeffamne godheera.

title: What to watch in Wisconsin’s high-stakes primary
english: Voters in Wisconsin are heading to the polls for a primary election that will determine candidates for governor, Congress, and state legislative seats. This contest is being closely watched as a critical test of whether the progressive wing of the Democratic Party can continue its recent momentum against more moderate establishment figures. The outcome is expected to reveal the political direction of Democratic voters ahead of the upcoming midterm elections in a key battleground state.
amharic: የዊስኮንሲን መራጮች ለገዢነት፣ ለኮንግረስ እና ለክልል ምክር ቤት እጩዎችን ለመምረጥ በቅድመ ምርጫው ድምጽ እየሰጡ ነው። ይህ የምርጫ ውድድር የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ተራማጅ ክንፍ በመካከለኛው ፓርቲ አመራሮች ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለመለካት እንደ ወሳኝ ፈተና እየታየ ነው። የምርጫው ውጤት በመጪው የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ላይ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ደጋፊዎች የሚከተሉት የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ምን እንደሚመስል ለማወቅ ይጠቅማል።
oromo: Meraatonni Wisconsin filannoo duraa kan hogganaa naannichaa, miseensota Kongiresii fi qaamolee seera baastuu naannichaa murteessuuf sagalee kennuuf qophaa'aniiru. Wal dorgommiin kun gareen dursaa (progressive) Paartii Dimookraatawaa qooda fudhannaa isaa guddifachuu fi haala itti aanuuf qophaa'uuf qormaata guddaa ta'ee ilaalama. Bu'aan filannoo kanaa filannoo gara fuulduraatti dhufu keessatti deggertoonni Paartii Dimookraatawaa karaa siyaasaa kam akka hordofan kan agarsiisu ta'a.

title: Syrian court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia
english: A Syrian court has handed down death sentences to former President Bashar al-Assad and several high-ranking officials. The ruling was issued in absentia after they were found guilty of severe human rights violations, including war crimes, torture, and the killing of children. These individuals were convicted for their roles in various crimes against humanity carried out during their time in power.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድን እና ሌሎች ከፍተኛ የመንግስት ባለስልጣናትን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወሰነ። ውሳኔው የተላለፈው እነሱ በሌሉበት ሲሆን፣ የጦር ወንጀል፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት እና ህጻናትን ማሰቃየትን ጨምሮ በከባድ ወንጀሎች ጥፋተኛ ሆነው በመገኘታቸው ነው። ይህ ብይን በስልጣን ላይ በነበሩበት ወቅት ለፈጸሟቸው የጭካኔ ድርጊቶች ምላሽ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa tokko pirezidaantii duraanii Bashar al-Assad fi qondaaltota mootummaa biroo irratti murtee du'aa dabarse. Murtiin kun kan darbe isaan bakka hin jirretti yoo ta'u, yakka waraanaa, yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatame fi ijoollee dararuu dabalatee yakka cimaa raawwachuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Murtiin kun yeroo aangoorratti turanitti yakka raawwatan irratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha.

title: ‘New level of danger’: Drone incidents scare Europe amid Russia-Ukraine war
english: A drone rigged with explosives recently breached security at Germany's Leipzig/Halle Airport, raising concerns about potential Russian sabotage operations across Europe. While German officials have not officially named Russia, intelligence reports and experts suggest this incident is part of a sophisticated hybrid warfare campaign. Consequently, nations in the Baltic region and Poland are heightening security measures to protect critical infrastructure against further drone incursions.
amharic: ፈንጂ የታሰረበት ድሮን በጀርመን ላይፕዚግ-ሃሌ አየር ማረፊያ የደህንነት ጥሶ በመግባቱ በአውሮፓ ውስጥ የሩሲያ የጥፋት ድርጊት ስጋትን ቀስቅሷል። የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ሩሲያን በግልፅ ባይጠቅሱም፣ የስለላ መረጃዎች እና ባለሙያዎች ይህ ክስተት የሩሲያ የተቀናጀ የጦርነት ስልት አካል እንደሆነ ይገልፃሉ። በዚህም የተነሳ፣ የባልቲክ አገራት እና ፖላንድ ለወሳኝ ተቋማቶቻቸው ያላቸውን ጥበቃ አጠናክረዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaaraan malee oofamu (droniin) qabiyyee dhootu qabate tokko buufata xiyyaaraa Jarmanii keessatti argamuun, sodaa gocha sabotaajii kan Rashiyaan Awurooppaa keessatti raawwachuu dandeessu dabaleera. Qaamoleen mootummaa Jarmanii Rashiyan akka isheen duubatti jirtu ifatti baasanii dubbachuu baatanis, gabaasni qorannoo fi ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti gochi kun tarsiimoo waraana gosa haaraa kan Rashiyaan gaggeessituudha. Kanaafuu, biyyoonni naannoo Baaltikii fi Pooland buufataalee fi tajaajila barbaachisaa ta'an eeggachuuf tika isaanii jabeessaniiru.

title: Future of southern Lebanon peacekeeping uncertain ahead of UNIFIL phase-out
english: The United Nations peacekeeping mission in southern Lebanon, known as UNIFIL, faces an uncertain future as its mandate nears expiration by the end of the year. While there is broad support for maintaining a presence, any replacement force is expected to be smaller and dependent on a broader regional political agreement. Experts emphasize that UNIFIL was never authorized to enforce peace or disarm groups, noting that long-term stability requires internal Lebanese and regional cooperation rather than just international monitoring.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚያካሂደው የሰላም አስከባሪ ተልዕኮ (UNIFIL) ማብቂያ ጊዜ እየተቃረበ በመምጣቱ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታው አጠያያቂ ሆኗል። አዲስ የሚቋቋመው የሰላም አስከባሪ ኃይል አነስተኛ ሊሆን እንደሚችል የሚጠበቅ ሲሆን፣ ስኬታማነቱም በአካባቢው ላይ በሚደረስ ሰፊ የፖለቲካ ስምምነት ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚያመለክቱት የተባበሩት መንግስታት ኃይል ሰላምን በኃይል ለማስከበር ስልጣን ያልነበረው በመሆኑ፣ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመገንባት የሊባኖስ የውስጥ ስምምነትና የክልሉ ሀገራት ትብብር ወሳኝ መሆኑን አስገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Ergamni nageenya eegumsaa tokkummaa mootummootaa kibba Libaanositti taasifamaa ture (UNIFIL) xumura waggaa irratti waan xumuramuuf, fuulduratti maaltu akka uumamu gaaffii keessa galeera. Ergamni bakka bu'uuf qophaa'u kun kan duraa caalaa xiqqaachuu fi waliigaltee siyaasaa naannichaa irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu mala. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, UNIFIL nageenya dirqamaan kabachiisuuf aangoo waan hin qabneef, nagaa waaraa argachuuf gumaachi qaama keessa Libaanosii fi naannichaa murteessaa ta'uu isaa hubachiisaniiru.

title: Palestine weekly: Netanyahu hedges on Gaza roadmap
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially rejected a 15-point peace roadmap for Gaza proposed by Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, maintaining that the military will not withdraw until Hamas is fully disarmed. Despite this public opposition, the intensity of violence in Gaza has decreased significantly over the past week. Meanwhile, reports suggest that Israel is initiating limited infrastructure projects in Rafah, though experts worry these efforts could lead to a permanent military presence rather than genuine humanitarian relief.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሰላም ቦርድ ያቀረቡትን የጋዛ የሰላም ካርታ ውድቅ አድርገው፣ ሀማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስኪፈታ ድረስ ወታደሮቻቸው ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ የይፋዊ ተቃውሞ ቢኖርም፣ ባለፉት ሳምንታት በጋዛ የነበረው የጥቃት መጠን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ይሁን እንጂ እስራኤል በራፋህ ከተማ መሠረታዊ የልማት ስራዎችን መጀመሯ የተነገረ ሲሆን፣ ይህም የሰብአዊ ድጋፍ ከመስጠት ይልቅ የእስራኤልን ወታደራዊ መገኘት በዘላቂነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu kaartaa nagaa Donald Trumpiin dhiyaate kan hin fudhanne ta'uu ibsuun, waraanni isaanii hamma Hamas guutummaatti hidhannoo hiikutti gaazaatii akka hin baane beeksisaniiru. Mormii kana keessa iyyuu, torban darbe keessa haleellaan gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa ture hir'ateera. Ta'us, Israa'el magaalaa Rafah keessatti hojiilee misoomaa murtaa'oo jalqabuu ishee gabaasni ni mul'isa; kunis gargaarsa namoomaa kennuu mannaa, waraanni Israa'el bakka sana akka hin baane gochuuf karoorfamee ta'uu danda'a jedhanii ogeeyyonni yaadda'aniiru.

title: Baby among those rescued as hundreds feared missing after Colombia quake
english: A powerful 7.4-magnitude earthquake struck western Colombia, causing widespread destruction and leveling thousands of buildings. Emergency teams are working urgently to find survivors after the disaster, which has claimed at least 132 lives and left hundreds more missing. Amid the devastation, rescue workers managed to save a baby from the wreckage, offering a glimmer of hope during the ongoing search effort.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በተከሰተ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ በርካታ ህንጻዎች በመውደማቸው ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። እስካሁን በተረጋገጠው መረጃ መሰረት 132 ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ሲሆን፣ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። በአስቸጋሪ የፍለጋ ስራው መካከል አንድ ህጻን ከህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ስር በህይወት መገኘቱ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti sochiin lafaa humna 7.4 qabu mudatee miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Balaa kanaan hanga ammaatti namoonni 132 lubbuun darban yoo ta'u, dhibboonni immoo bakka buutee isaanii dhabameera. Iddoo lafti itti diigame keessaa namoonni oolchaa jiran keessaa mucaan tokko lubbuun argamuun isaa abdii kennee jira.

title: What to know about South Carolina’s election to replace Lindsey Graham
english: South Carolina is holding a special primary election this Tuesday to select a new Republican candidate for the US Senate following the unexpected death of Senator Lindsey Graham. Ten candidates, including Graham's sister Darline, are competing to replace him as the nominee for the upcoming November midterms. The winner of this primary will face Democratic opponent Annie Andrews in the general election.
amharic: የደቡብ ካሮላይና ግዛት ሴናተር ሊንድዚ ግራሃም በድንገት ከማለፋቸው ጋር ተያይዞ፣ ለቀጣዩ የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ምርጫ አዲስ የሪፐብሊካን እጩ ለመምረጥ ማክሰኞ ዕለት ልዩ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ነው። በሴናተሩ እህት ዳርሊን ግራሃም የሚመሩ አስር እጩዎች ለቦታው እየተወዳደሩ ሲሆን፣ አሸናፊውም በህዳር ወር በሚካሄደው ዋና ምርጫ ከዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩ አኒ አንድሪውስ ጋር ይወዳደራሉ።
oromo: Senator Lindzi Girehaam tasa du'uu isaatiin wal-qabatee, mootummaan South Carolina filannoo bakka bu'insa seneteera isaanii guutuuf guyyaa Kibxata kana filannoo addaa gaggeessaa jira. Obboleettii seneterichaa Daarlin Girehaam dabalatee namoonni kudhan kaadhimamtoota riippabilikaan ta'uuf dorgomaa jiru. Mo'ataan filannoo kanaa kunis filannoo guddicha kan ji'a Sadaasaa irratti kaadhimamtuu paaritii Dimokiraata kan taate Aanii Andreews waliin kan dorgomu ta'a.

title: DRC Ebola death toll passes 2,000 amid fastest-growing outbreak on record
english: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its most rapid Ebola outbreak ever, with confirmed deaths surpassing 2,000. Over 4,300 cases have been reported across five provinces, fueled by challenges such as misinformation, cultural burial practices, and health worker strikes. While vaccine trials are currently in progress, there is no verified treatment yet for this specific strain of the virus.
amharic: የኮንጎ ዲሞክራሲያዊ ሪፐብሊክ እስካሁን ካጋጠማት እጅግ ፈጣን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ጋር እየታገለች ሲሆን፣ የሟቾች ቁጥርም ከ2,000 አልፏል። በአምስት ግዛቶች ውስጥ ከ4,300 በላይ በበሽታው የተያዙ ሰዎች የተመዘገቡ ሲሆን፣ የተሳሳቱ መረጃዎች፣ ባህላዊ የቀብር ሥነ-ሥርዓቶች እና የጤና ባለሙያዎች አድማ ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ አድርገውታል። ምንም እንኳን የክትባት ሙከራዎች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ ለዚህ የኢቦላ ዝርያ እስካሁን የጸደቀ መድኃኒት የለም።
oromo: Jamhuuriyya Dimokiraatawaa Koongoo keessatti dhibeen Ebola saffisaan babal'achaa jiru lubbuu namoota 2,000 ol galaafatee jira. Godinoota shan keessatti namoota 4,300 ol irratti kan mirkanaa'e yoo ta'u, odeeffannoo dogoggoraa, aadaa awwaalchaa fi sochii hojjettoota fayyaa irratti gufuun mudate to'annoo dhibichaa ulfaataa taasisee jira. Qorannoon talaallii osoo gaggeeffamaa jiruus, dhibee kanaaf qorichi ykn talaalliin dhugoomfame hanga ammaatti hin jiru.

title: East Libya military intelligence chief killed in car bomb
english: Major-General Fawzi al-Mansouri, the head of military intelligence for eastern Libya, was killed in a car bombing in Benghazi. The attack occurred when an explosive device detonated as he entered his vehicle outside his home. Eastern Libyan officials have condemned the assassination and promised to investigate the perpetrators of this violent act.
amharic: የምስራቅ ሊቢያ የጦር መረጃ ዋና ሃላፊ የሆኑት ሜጀር ጀነራል ፋውዚ አል-ማንሱሪ በቤንጋዚ ከተማ በተፈጸመ የመኪና ቦምብ ጥቃት ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ጄነራሉ ከቤታቸው ውጭ ወደ መኪናቸው ሲገቡ በተጠመደ ፈንጂ ነው። የምስራቅ ሊቢያ ባለስልጣናት ግድያውን አውግዘው፣ ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙትን ወንጀለኞች በህግ ፊት እንደሚያቀርቡ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan sitti-himaa waraanaa kan Baha Libiyaa kan ta'an Mejer Jeneraal Fawzi al-Mansuurin, magaalaa Bengaazii keessatti boombii konkolaataa irratti hidhamee tureen ajjeefaman. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo isaan mana isaanii duratti konkolaataa isaanii seenaa turanitti boombiin sun dhohee dha. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Baha Libiyaa gocha kana balaaleeffachuun, yakka kana kan raawwatan qaamolee seeraaf akka dhiyeessan waadaa galaniiru.

title: Israel pursuing ‘undeclared annexation’ of West Bank, Peace Now says
english: The advocacy group Peace Now has accused the Israeli government of effectively annexing parts of the West Bank by expanding its administrative control into areas previously managed by Palestinians. By increasing military and civilian authority over regions under the Oslo Accords, the group argues that officials are violating international agreements to seize more land. This shift in policy allows Israeli agencies to intervene in Palestinian construction and urban planning, threatening long-standing territorial arrangements.
amharic: ፒስ ናው የተባለው ቡድን የእስራኤል መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ የነበሩ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ስልጣኖችን በመቀማት በይፋ ያልታወጀ ወረራ እያካሄደ ነው ሲል ከሰሰ። መንግስት በኦስሎ ስምምነት መሰረት በፍልስጤማውያን ቁጥጥር ስር በነበሩ አካባቢዎች የራሱን ሲቪል እና ወታደራዊ አስተዳደር በማስፋፋቱ አለም አቀፍ ስምምነቶችን እየጣሰ ነው ብሏል። ይህ ድርጊት እስራኤል በፍልስጤም መሬት ላይ ተጨማሪ ቁጥጥር ለማድረግ የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ቡድኑ ገልጿል።
oromo: Jaarmayaan ‘Peace Now’ jedhamu, mootummaan Israa’el naannoo Qarqaraa (West Bank) keessatti aangoosaa babal'isuun lafa biyyoota biroo qabatamaa akka jiru himateera. Mootummaan kun walii galtee Oslo cabsuun, aangoosaa naannoo ummanni Palastayinii bulchaa ture keessatti dirqiin babal'isaa jiraachuu gabaasichi ibsa. Tarkaanfiin kun ijaarsaafi karoora magaalaa Palastayinii keessa seenuuf kan gargaaruufi lafa dabalataa to'achuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu gabaasni kun ni addeessa.

title: Qatar says Oman-Iran talks on Hormuz in advanced stage
english: A Qatari official recently announced that negotiations between Oman and Iran regarding maritime security in the Strait of Hormuz have reached an advanced phase. These discussions focus on determining the future of shipping operations through this critical waterway. The update highlights ongoing regional efforts to ensure stability in the area.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ውስጥ ስላለው የመርከብ ጉዞ የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ በኦማን እና በኢራን መካከል የሚደረገው ድርድር ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን የኳታር የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ውይይቶች በስትራቴጂካዊው የባህር መስመር ላይ የንግድ እንቅስቃሴን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ በቀጠናው መረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር እየተደረጉ ያሉ ጥረቶችን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaan Qatar akka beeksisetti, mariin biyyoota Oman fi Iran gidduutti karaa bishaan Hormuz irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru sadarkaa gaarii irra ga'eera. Mariin kun gara fuulduraatti karaa daldala galana kanaa tasgabbeessuu fi nageenya isaa eeguurratti kan xiyyeeffatu dha. Kunis naannichatti nagaa fi tasgabbii buusuuf carraaqqii taasifamaa jiru kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
english: Former President Donald Trump secretly switched aircraft while departing a NATO summit in Turkey last month to avoid a potential Iranian missile threat. He reportedly used a catering truck to sneak onto a smaller military plane while his staff and the media remained unaware on his original jet. This complex maneuver allowed him to reach the UK safely before ultimately returning to the United States.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ባለፈው ወር በቱርክ በተካሄደ የኔቶ ጉባኤ ወቅት፣ ከኢራን ሊሰነዘር ይችላል በተባለ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት ለመትረፍ ሚስጥራዊ የአውሮፕላን ቅያሬ አድርገዋል። በዘገባው መሰረት፣ ዋናው አውሮፕላን ላይ እንደገቡ በማስመሰል በምግብ ማመላለሻ መኪና አማካኝነት በድብቅ ወደ ሌላ ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላን ተዛውረዋል። ይህ ድርጊት የፕሬዝዳንቱ ሰራተኞች እና ጋዜጠኞች ሳይረዱት የተፈጸመ ሲሆን፣ ትራምፕ ደህና ሁኔታ ላይ ሆነው ጉዞአቸውን ወደ እንግሊዝ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantii duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp ji'a darbe biyya Turkii keessatti yaa'ii Naattoo booda, sodaan weerara mizaayilaa Iraan waan tureef xiyyaara isaanirra jiran gara biraatti akka geeddaran gabaasameera. Traamp xiyyaara gurguddaa keessa seenuuf qophii erga godhatanii booda, akka tasaa konkolaataa nyaata fe'uun gara xiyyaara waraanaa xinnootti akka darban himameera. Haalli kun ogeessota mana mootummaa fi gabaastota biratti dhokataa waan tureef, Traamp nagaadhaan biyya Ingiliz ga'anii gara Ameerikaatti deebi'uuf danda'aniiru.

title: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claims that Russia is now utilizing North Korean ballistic missiles to conduct deadly attacks on Ukrainian cities, including a recent strike in Zaporizhzhia that caused several casualties. In retaliation, Ukraine continues to target critical Russian infrastructure deep within its territory, including industrial plants and warehouses. Zelensky warns that this military cooperation with North Korea not only escalates the conflict but also poses a growing global security threat.
amharic: የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ከተሞች ላይ ለሚሰነዘሩ ገዳይ ጥቃቶች የሰሜን ኮሪያ ባለስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን እየተጠቀመች እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። በምላሹም ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ግዛት ውስጥ በሚገኙ ወሳኝ የኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማት እና መጋዘኖች ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን ቀጥላለች። ዘለንስኪ ይህ ከሰሜን ኮሪያ ጋር ያለው ወታደራዊ ትብብር ግጭቱን ከማባባሱም በላይ ለአለም አቀፍ ደህንነት ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Yukreen Volodimiir Zeeleniskii, Raashiyaan magaalonni Yukreen irratti haleellaa ajjeesaa raawwachuuf misaa'ela biyya Koree Kaabaa fayyadamaa akka jirtu ibsaniiru. Kana dura Zaappooriizhiyaa keessatti haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Karaa biraatiin, Yukreenis bakkee gurguddaa Raashiyaa fi bakkeewwan oomishaalee gubuu ishee itti fuftee jirti. Zeeleniskii hariiroon waraanaa Koree Kaabaa waliin uumame kun rakkoo biyyattii qofa osoo hin taane, nageenya addunyaafis balaa guddaa akka ta'e akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Ousted Syrian dictator Bashar al-Assad sentenced to death in absentia
english: A Syrian court has sentenced former leader Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia for war crimes and crimes against humanity committed during his rule. Assad, who fled to Russia in December 2024 following his regime's collapse, was convicted alongside his cousin, Atef Najib, who received the same sentence. While the new Syrian government is pursuing justice for the victims of the civil war, it remains uncertain if Russia will agree to extradite the ousted dictator.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን መሪ በሻር አል አሳድ በስልጣን ዘመናቸው በፈጸሙት የጦር ወንጀል እና የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰት በሌሉበት የሞት ቅጣት ፈረደባቸው። አሳድ የዘመናቸው ስርዓት በታህሳስ 2024 ከወደቀ በኋላ ወደ ሩሲያ የሸሹ ሲሆን፣ አብረዋቸው የተፈረደባቸው የአጎታቸው ልጅ አቴፍ ናጂብም ተመሳሳይ ፍርድ ተላልፎባቸዋል። አዲሱ የሶሪያ መንግስት ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ ለመስጠት እየሰራ ቢሆንም፣ አሳድን ከሩሲያ አሳልፎ ማምጣት ይቻል እንደሆነ እስካሁን ግልጽ አይደለም።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa duraanii Baashar al-Asaad ajjeechaa fi yakka waraanaa raawwataniin bakka hin jirreetti adabbii du'aa itti murteesseera. Asaad sirni isaanii erga kufee booda bara 2024 gara Raashiyaa kan baqatan yoo ta'u, fira isaanii Ateef Naajiib jedhamus adabbii walfakkaatuun itti murteeffameera. Mootummaan Suuriyaa haaraan miidhamtootaaf haqaa kennuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiruus, mootummaan Raashiyaa Asaad dabarsee akka kennu abdii guddaan hin jiru.

title: Libyan authorities battle big blaze at major oil refinery
english: A major fuel refinery in Zawiya, Libya, was struck by a drone attack, causing a massive fire that destroyed a large fuel tank. While no serious injuries were reported, the National Oil Corporation is now considering halting operations due to this repeated violence. These attacks underscore the ongoing political instability and division within the country.
amharic: በሊቢያ ዛዊያ ከተማ በሚገኝ ዋና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት ትልቅ የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቷል። ጥቃቱ የነዳጅ ማጠራቀሚያ ታንከርን ሙሉ በሙሉ ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ በሰዎች ላይ የከፋ ጉዳት ባይኖርም የነዳጅ ኮርፖሬሽኑ ቀጣይ የደህንነት ስጋቶችን በመፍራት የማጣሪያ ጣቢያውን ስራ ለማቆም እያሰበ ነው። ይህ ክስተት በሊቢያ ውስጥ ያለውን የረጅም ጊዜ አለመረጋጋት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Buufata qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa guddaa Zawiyaa, Liibiyaa keessatti argamu irratti haleellaan xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeeffameen ibidni guddaan ka'eera. Haleellaa kanaan taankiin boba'aa guddaan tokko kan barbadaa'e yoo ta'u, miidhaan qaamaa cimaan nama irra ga'uu baatus, dhaabbanni boba'aa biyyattii nageenyaa fi walitti fufiinsa haleellichaatiif sodaachun hojii dhaabuuf karoorsaa jira. Haleellaan kun tasgabbii dhabuu fi gargar bahiinsa biyyattii keessa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Who is Atef Najib, former Syrian official sentenced to death with al-Assad?
english: A Damascus court has sentenced former security official Atef Najib to death for his role in the 2011 crackdown on protesters in Deraa. Najib, a cousin of the ousted Bashar al-Assad, was found guilty of serious offenses including murder, torture, and crimes against humanity. While Bashar and Maher al-Assad received the same sentence in absentia, Najib is currently being held in custody within Syria.
amharic: የደማስቆ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞ የፀጥታ ሃላፊ የነበሩትን አቴፍ ናጂብ በ2011 በዴራ በሰላማዊ ሰልፈኞች ላይ በወሰዱት የኃይል እርምጃ ምክንያት በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ከተገለበጡት የሶሪያ መሪ ባሻር አል-አሳድ ጋር ዝምድና ያላቸው አቴፍ ናጂብ፣ ግድያን፣ ስቃይን እና በሰው ልጆች ላይ የተፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ከባድ ክሶች ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ባሻር እና ማሄር አል-አሳድ በሌሉበት የሞት ቅጣት ቢበየንባቸውም፣ ናጂብ ግን በአሁኑ ወቅት በሶሪያ ውስጥ በእስር ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii Damasqoo, aanga'aa nageenyaa duraanii Ateef Naajiib jedhaman irratti, bara 2011 magaalaa Deeraa keessatti hiriira bahanii turan irratti tarkaanfii fudhatameef adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Ateef Naajiib, kanneen aangoo irraa bu'an Baashar Al-Asaad waliin dhihoo kan walitti hidhatan yoo ta'u, ajjeechaa, dararaa fi yakka namoomaa irratti raawwatame jedhamuun himatamanii turan. Baashar fi Maahir Al-Asaad adabbii du'aa kana kan argatan bakka hin jirretti ta'us, Naajiib garuu yeroo ammaa kana biyya Siiriyaa keessatti hidhaa keessa jiru.

title: Bangladesh and India battle to save cricket series after political turmoil
english: Bangladesh and India are currently working at a high government level to rescue an upcoming six-match cricket series that was previously delayed. Relations between the two countries have been strained since the 2024 political uprising in Bangladesh that led to the ousting of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. Officials are now holding diplomatic talks to resolve the deadlock and restore sporting ties between the neighbors.
amharic: ባንግላዲሽ እና ህንድ ከዚህ ቀደም ተስተጓጉሎ የነበረውን ስድስት ጨዋታዎችን ያካተተ የክሪኬት ውድድር ለማካሄድ በከፍተኛ የመንግስት ደረጃ ድርድር እያደረጉ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግንኙነት የተበላሸው እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 በባንግላዲሽ በተቀሰቀሰው ህዝባዊ አመጽ የቀድሞዋ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና ከስልጣን ከተወገዱ በኋላ ነው። በአሁኑ ወቅት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶች እየተካሄዱ ያሉት ውዝግቡን በማርገብ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የስፖርት ግንኙነት ለማደስ ነው።
oromo: Bangladeshiifi Indiyaan tapha kriketii taphni ja'a keessatti argamu kan kanaan dura ture deebisanii jalqabuuf gargaarsa mootummaan mari'achaa jiru. Walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii kan hir'ate, bara 2024tti Bangladeshitti jijjiirama siyaasaa mudateen booda yeroo muummee ministiraa duraanii Sheek Haasiinaan aangoo irraa bu'an irraa kaaseeti. Amma mootummootni lamaan walii galtee uumuun taphoota kana deebisanii fiduuf marii dippilomaasii geggeessaa jiru.

title: The Global South’s digital future must not belong to Bezos and Musk
english: Amazon’s satellite internet is expanding into rural Africa, following the rapid growth of Elon Musk’s Starlink in developing regions. While these services promise to connect underserved communities, there are significant concerns about long-term reliance on powerful foreign corporations that are closely linked to US national interests. Experts warn that allowing private tech giants to control critical digital infrastructure could give them excessive influence over the economies and political systems of developing nations.
amharic: የአማዞን የሳተላይት ኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት፣ የኤሎን መስክ ስታርሊንክን ተከትሎ በአፍሪካ ገጠራማ አካባቢዎች እየተስፋፋ ይገኛል። እነዚህ አገልግሎቶች የተገለሉ ማህበረሰቦችን የማገናኘት አቅም ቢኖራቸውም፣ ከአሜሪካ ብሔራዊ ጥቅም ጋር የተሳሰሩ ግዙፍ የውጭ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ጥገኛ መሆን አሳሳቢ ነው። የቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያዎች ወሳኝ የዲጂታል መሠረተ ልማቶችን መቆጣጠራቸው በታዳጊ ሀገራት ኢኮኖሚ እና ፖለቲካ ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Tajaajilli intarneetii saatalaayitii kan Amazon, kan Elon Musk Starlink jedhamu hordofuun naannolee baadiyaa Afrikaa keessatti babal'achaa jira. Tajaajiloonni kunniin hawaasa tajaajila hin arganne wal qunnamsiisuuf abdii kan kennan ta'us, dhaabbilee alaa humna qabanii fi fedhii biyya Ameerikaa wajjin walitti hidhata qaban irratti hirkachuun sodaa guddaa qaba. Dhaabbileen tekinooloojii gurguddoon bu'uuraalee misoomaa dijitaalaa to'achuun isaanii, dinagdee fi sirna siyaasaa biyyoota guddataa jiran irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu akka danda'u ogeeyyiin akeekkachiisu.

title: Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region suffers as US-Iran war drags on
english: The semi-autonomous Kurdistan region of Iraq is facing severe consequences from the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran. Despite maintaining neutrality, the region has endured over 1,000 missile and drone attacks that have damaged infrastructure and caused casualties. These hostilities have crippled the local economy, resulting in a 70 percent drop in trade and over a billion dollars in financial losses.
amharic: የኢራቅ የኩርዲስታን ክልል በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ክልሉ ገለልተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ከ1,000 በላይ የሚሆኑ የሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃቶች ደርሰውበታል፤ ይህም ለሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና ለንብረት ውድመት ምክንያት ሆኗል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የንግድ ልውውጥን በ70 በመቶ በመቀነሳቸው ክልሉ ከ1 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የኢኮኖሚ ኪሳራ አጋጥሞታል።
oromo: Naannoon Kordistaan kan Iraaq waraana Ameerikaa, Israa'elii fi Iraan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiruun miidhaa guddaa keessa jira. Naannoon kun waraana keessa akka hin galle yoo ibse iyyuu, roorroo fi haleellaa dhooyitii fi 'dronii' 1,000 ol ta'een miidhaan guddaan qaamaa fi qabeenyaa irra ga'eera. Haleellaa kanaan wal-qabatee daldalli naannichaa gara dhibbeentaa 70n gadi bu'uu fi miidhaan dinagdee doolaara biliyoona tokkoo ol akka ga'e gabaasameera.

title: Vietnam’s VinSpace announces deal with SpaceX to launch first satellite
english: The Vietnamese aerospace company VinSpace has signed a contract with SpaceX to launch its debut satellites in early 2027. This partnership will allow the firm to test its internally developed technology in orbit while working to build a commercial space industry in Vietnam. Owned by billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong, VinSpace aims to integrate the country into the global space market by managing its own satellite operations.
amharic: የቬትናሙ የጠፈር ምርምር ድርጅት ቪን ስፔስ (VinSpace) የመጀመሪያ ሳተላይቶቹን በ2027 መጀመሪያ ላይ ወደ ጠፈር ለመላክ ከኤሎን መስክ ስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) ጋር ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ትብብር ኩባንያው በራሱ ያዘጋጀውን ቴክኖሎጂ በጠፈር ውስጥ እንዲሞክር እና በቬትናም የጠፈር ንግድ ዘርፍን እንዲገነባ ያስችለዋል። የቢሊየነሩ ፋም ንሃት ቩኦንግ ንብረት የሆነው ቪን ስፔስ፣ የሳተላይት ስራዎችን በራሱ በመምራት ቬትናምን በአለም አቀፍ የጠፈር ገበያ ውስጥ ለማስገባት አቅዷል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni qorannoo hawaa Vi'etnaam 'VinSpace' jedhamu, satalaayitoota isaa jalqabaa bara 2027 keessa gara hawaatti erguuf dhaabbata Elon Musk kan ta'e 'SpaceX' waliin waliigalteerra ga'eera. Tumsi kun dhaabbatichi teeknoolojii ofiin qopheeffate hawaa keessatti akka qoruufi industirii daldala hawaa Vi'etnaam keessatti akka babal'isu isa gargaara. Abbaan qabeenyaa biyyattii Pham Nhat Vuong kan ta'e 'VinSpace', hojii satalaayitii ofiin hogganuun Vi'etnaam gabaa hawaa addunyaa keessatti qooda akka qabaattuuf carraaqaa jira.

title: Court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia in landmark trial
english: A Syrian court has issued a death sentence for former president Bashar al-Assad, his brother, and a top security official. They were found guilty of serious crimes, including the intentional killing of children, torture, and crimes against humanity. While the official was present for the trial, Assad and his brother were sentenced in absentia as they have fled the country.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድን፣ ወንድማቸውን እና ሌላ ከፍተኛ የፀጥታ ባለስልጣን በሞት እንዲቀጡ ወስኗል። ግለሰቦቹ ህጻናትን በመግደል፣ በማሰቃየት እና በሰብአዊነት ላይ የሚፈጸሙ ወንጀሎችን በመፈጸም ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። የፀጥታ ባለስልጣኑ በችሎት ቢገኙም፣ አል-አሳድ እና ወንድማቸው ከአገር በመውጣታቸው ብይን የተሰጠባቸው በሌሉበት ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa duraanii pirezidaantii Baashaar al-Asaad, obboleessa isaa fi qondaala nageenyaa ol’aanaa tokko irratti murtee du’aa dabarseera. Namoonni kunniin ijoollee ajjeesuu, dararuu fi yakka namummaa irratti raawwatamuun himatamuun isaanii mirkanaa’eera. Qondaalli nageenyaa kun mana murtii kan argame yoo ta’u, Asaad fi obboleessi isaa biyyaa baqachuu isaaniitiin murtiin kun kan darbe isaan bakka hin jirreetti.

title: Colombia recognises Israeli sovereignty over Golan Heights
english: Colombia’s new president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has officially recognized Israeli sovereignty over the Golan Heights, marking a significant shift from his predecessor's policies. This move makes Colombia only the second nation, after the United States, to support Israel's control of the territory. The Israeli government welcomed the decision, citing it as vital for their national security and defense.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያው አዲሱ ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ እስራኤል በጎላን ኮረብታ ላይ ያላትን ሉዓላዊነት በይፋ እውቅና ሰጥተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ከቀድሞው አስተዳደር ፖሊሲ በመውጣት ኮሎምቢያ ከአሜሪካ ቀጥላ የጎላን ኮረብታን የእስራኤል ግዛት አድርጋ በመቀበል ሁለተኛዋ ሀገር ሆናለች። የእስራኤል መንግስት ይህ ውሳኔ ለሀገራቸው ደህንነት እና መከላከያ ወሳኝ ነው በማለት ምስጋናውን አቅርቧል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Kolombiyaa haaraan, Abelardo de la Espriella, labsii mootummaan Israa'el naannoo Golan Heights irratti qabu beekkamtii kennan. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii aangoo duraa irraa garaagarummaa guddaa kan mul'isu yoo ta'u, Kolombiyaan Ameerikaatti aansuun biyya lammaffaa naannoo kana irratti aangoo Israa'el fudhatte taateetti. Mootummaan Israa'el murtee kana eeguun nageenya fi ittisa biyya isaaniitiif murteessaa dha jechuun galata galchaniiru.

title: UKMTO reports incident involving military in Gulf of Oman
english: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency has reported a security incident in the Gulf of Oman involving a tanker and military personnel. The organization has issued an official warning to vessels operating in the region as they investigate the situation. Authorities have not yet provided specific details regarding the nature of the encounter or the identity of the military forces involved.
amharic: የዩናይትድ ኪንግደም የባህር ንግድ ኦፕሬሽንስ ኤጀንሲ በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በታንከር መርከብ እና በወታደራዊ ኃይሎች መካከል የተፈጠረ የደህንነት ችግር መኖሩን አስታውቋል። ተቋሙ በአካባቢው ለሚንቀሳቀሱ መርከቦች የጥንቃቄ ማስጠንቀቂያ የሰጠ ሲሆን ጉዳዩን እየመረመረ እንደሚገኝ ገልጿል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ስለ ግጭቱ ሁኔታ ወይም ስለ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎቹ ማንነት እስካሁን ምንም ዓይነት ዝርዝር መረጃ አልሰጡም።
oromo: Hojii Daldala Galaana UK kan ta'e (UKMTO), baha galaana Omaan keessatti markaba boba'aa fe'u fi humnoota waraanaa gidduutti rakkoon nageenyaa uumamuu isaa gabaaseera. Dhaabbatichi qorannoo geggeessaa akka jiru ibsuun, markaboota naannicha keessa jiran hundaaf akeekkachiisa dabarseera. Haata'u malee, humni waraanaa kun eenyu akka ta'e ykn rakkoon kun maal akka ta'e hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane.

title: Brent oil price passes $90 as Iran-US deal hopes fade
english: Global oil prices have risen above $90 per barrel as negotiations between the United States and Iran regarding conflict resolution have stalled. Tensions increased after both nations made conflicting financial demands for war reparations, dimming prospects for a peaceful agreement. This geopolitical instability has caused energy costs to climb significantly over the past week.
amharic: በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ስምምነት ተስፋ በመሟጠጡ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከአንድ በርሜል 90 ዶላር በላይ ከፍ ብሏል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት ለጦርነት ካሳ አንዳቸው ከሌላው የገንዘብ ክፍያ በመጠየቃቸው ውጥረቱ እየተባባሰ ሄዷል። ይህ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት ባለፉት ሳምንታት የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲጨምር ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hirmaannaa fi mariin biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti godhamaa ture waan hin milkoofneef gatiin boba'aa kuta tokkoo ykn baarel tokkoon 90 doolaara ol darbeera. Biyyoonni lameen kun kaffaltii beenyaa waraanaa wal gaafachuu isaaniitiin wal dhabbiin isaanii hammaatee jira. Rakkoon siyaasaa kun immoo torbanoota darban keessa gatiin boba'aa akka ol ka'u taasiseera.

title: Rescue efforts intensify as quake devastates western Colombia towns
english: A massive 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck western Colombia, resulting in at least 132 deaths and thousands of missing persons. Emergency responders and local residents are currently searching through the debris of over 1,600 collapsed buildings to find survivors. The government has mobilized the military and received international aid to assist the hardest-hit, isolated regions.
amharic: በምዕራብ ኮሎምቢያ በደረሰ ከባድ የ7.4 ማግኒቲዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ቢያንስ 132 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩም የት እንዳሉ አይታወቅም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች እና የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የፈራረሱ ህንጻዎችን በመቆፈር የተረፉ ሰዎችን ለመፈለግ ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። መንግስት ወታደራዊ ሃይልን በማሰማራት ከአለም አቀፍ አጋሮች እርዳታ በመቀበል በተጎዱ አካባቢዎች የነፍስ አድን ስራውን አጠናክሮ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Kolombiyaa lixaatti lafti socho’uun balaa cimaa gahe kanaan namoonni 132 ol yoo du’an, kumaatamaan kan lakkaa’aman immoo bakka buutee isaanii dhabameera. Humnoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa fi jiraattonni naannichaa, iddoo manni itti diigame keessatti namoota lubbuun hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru. Mootummaan raayyaa ittisaa bobbaasuun akkasumas gargaarsa idil-addunyaa argachuun naannolee balaan cimaan gahe deeggaraa jira.

title: Swiatek to face Svitolina in Canadian Open semifinal
english: Iga Swiatek secured her spot in the Canadian Open semifinals with a dominant victory over Diana Shnaider. She will now face Elina Svitolina, who reached this stage after completing a comeback win against Ekaterina Alexandrova. This match is a significant milestone for Swiatek as she looks to regain her form ahead of the upcoming US Open.
amharic: ኢጋ ስዋይቴክ ዲያና ሽናይደርን በማሸነፍ የካናዳ ኦፕን የሴሚፎናል ምዕራፍ ላይ ደርሳለች። በሴሚፎናሉ የዩክሬኗን ኤሊና ስቪቶሊናን የምትገጥም ይሆናል፤ ስቪቶሊና ወደዚህ ደረጃ የደረሰችው ኤካቴሪና አሌክሳንድሮቫን በመርታት ነው። ስዋይቴክ ወደፊት በሚካሄደው የዩኤስ ኦፕን ውድድር ላይ ጥሩ ብቃት ለማሳየት ይህ ድል ትልቅ አስተዋፅኦ ይኖረዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Iga Swiatek injifannoo salphaa Diana Shnaider irratti argachuun gara semi-fayinaalii kaanaadaa Opanii darbiteetti. Semi-fayinaalichatti, Ekaterina Alexandrova injifattee kan dhufe Elina Svitolina waliin kan wal morkatan ta'a. Injifannoon kun Swiatek dorgommii Yuu Es Opanii dhufuuf qophii gaarii akka gootuuf gargaaruu danda'a.

title: What to know about the US primaries in Connecticut, Vermont, and Alabama
english: Voters in Connecticut, Vermont, and Alabama are heading to the polls for primary elections to select candidates for the upcoming November midterms. In Connecticut, Governor Ned Lamont faces a progressive challenger named Josh Elliott in a race focused on tax and fiscal policy. Meanwhile, Alabama is holding special primary elections for U.S. House seats following a redrawing of the state's electoral district map.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የኮነቲከት፣ የቨርሞንት እና የአላባማ ግዛቶች ለህዳር ወር አጠቃላይ ምርጫ ተወዳዳሪዎችን ለመለየት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫቸውን እያካሄዱ ነው። በኮነቲከት፣ አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ገዢ ኔድ ላሞንት ከጆሽ ኤሊዮት ጋር የውስጥ ፓርቲ ውድድር እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ ውድድሩም በታክስ እና በኢኮኖሚ ፖሊሲዎች ዙሪያ ያጠነጠነ ነው። በአላባማ ደግሞ የምርጫ ክልሎች ካርታ ከተቀየረ በኋላ ለአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እጩዎችን ለመምረጥ ልዩ ምርጫ እየተካሄደ ነው።
oromo: Filattoonni biyyoota Ameerikaa kanneen akka Konektikat, Vermoont fi Alaabaamaa, filannoo guddicha kan Sadaasaa kahuuf murtii kennuuf qophiirra jiru. Konektikat keessatti, guvernarri amma jiran Ned Lamont fi morkataan isaanii Josh Elliott siyaasa diinagdee fi taaksii irratti xiyyeeffachuun wal dorgomaa jiru. Alaabaamaa keessattis, kaartaan naannoolee filannoo erga jijjiiramee booda, bakka buutota Mana Maree Ameerikaaf dorgomtoota filachuuf filannoon addaa gaggeeffamaa jira.

title: ‘My father is in RSS’: India’s Gen Z confronts Modi-loving parents at home
english: Young Indians from families supporting the ruling BJP party are increasingly challenging their parents' political views by joining mass protests against the government. These Gen Z activists are demanding significant education reforms following nationwide scandals involving leaked exam papers. This generational divide is creating unprecedented domestic tension as youth activists reject the ideology of the RSS, which serves as the ideological foundation for the current administration.
amharic: በህንድ ውስጥ የአገሪቱን ገዥ ፓርቲ የሚደግፉ ቤተሰቦች ያሏቸው ወጣቶች፣ በወላጆቻቸው የፖለቲካ አመለካከት ላይ በመቃወም በአገሪቱ እየተካሄዱ ባሉ ተቃውሞዎች ላይ እየተሳተፉ ይገኛሉ። የዘመኑ ወጣቶች (Gen Z) በተለይም የፈተና ጥያቄዎች መሰረቃቸውን ተከትሎ በትምህርት ስርዓቱ ላይ ሰፊ ማሻሻያ እንዲደረግ እየጠየቁ ነው። ይህ የአመለካከት ልዩነት፣ ወጣቶች ለገዥው መንግስት መሰረት የሆነውን የRSS ርዕዮተ ዓለም በመቃወማቸው በቤተሰቦች መካከል ከፍተኛ መለያየትን እያስከተለ ነው።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti dargaggoonni maatiin isaanii paartii biyya bulchu BJP deeggaran, ilaalcha siyaasaa maatii isaanii mormuun hiriira mormii biyyoolessaarratti hirmaachaa jiru. Dargaggoonni kun gabaa qormaataa waliin walqabatee rakkoo uumameen walqabatee sirna barnootaa keessatti jijjiirama barbaadu. Walitti buutiin ilaalchaa kun, dargaggoonni dhaabbata RSS kan biyyattii bulchaa jiruuf bu'uura ta'e mormuu isaaniitiin maatii keessatti waldhabdee guddaa uumaa jira.

title: Bashar al-Assad, Atef Najib sentenced to death in landmark Syria trial
english: A Syrian court has handed down death sentences to former president Bashar al-Assad and former security official Atef Najib. They were found guilty of premeditated murder and crimes against humanity stemming from their actions during the 2011 uprising in Deraa. Additionally, Najib was convicted for his role in the torture of citizens during the civil war.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን ፕሬዝዳንት ባሻር አል-አሳድን እና የደህንነት ኦፊሰር የነበሩትን አተፍ ናጂብን በሞት ቀጣ። ሁለቱም በ2011 በደራ ግዛት በተካሄደው ግጭት በሰው ልጆች ላይ ለፈጸሙት ወንጀል እና ለታቀደ ግድያ ጥፋተኛ ሆነው ተገኝተዋል። ናጂብ በተጨማሪም በዜጎች ላይ ድብደባ እና ማሰቃየት በመፈጸሙ ተጨማሪ ክስ ቀርቦበታል።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaatti pirezidaantii duraanii Bashar al-Assad fi hoggansaa nageenyaa Atef Najib irratti adabbii du'aa murteesseera. Isaan kun bara 2011 magaalota Deraa keessatti yakka namoomaa fi ajjeechaa karooraan raawwatameef itti gaafatamtoota ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Kana malees, Najib namoota hidhatanii turan irratti dararama fi reebicha raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'eera.

title: Syria: Court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia in landmark trial
english: A Syrian court has sentenced former leader Bashar al-Assad, his brother Maher, and former official Atef Najib to death for crimes against humanity, including torture and murder. While Najib faced the court in person, the Assad brothers were tried in absentia as they currently reside in Moscow. This historic ruling marks the first major legal action taken by the nation's new transitional government against the former regime.
amharic: የሶሪያ ፍርድ ቤት የቀድሞውን መሪ በሽር አል-አሰድን፣ ወንድማቸውን ማህርን እና የቀድሞ ባለስልጣን አቴፍ ናጂብን በግድያ፣ በስቃይ እና በሰው ልጆች ላይ በተፈጸሙ ወንጀሎች ጥፋተኛ ብሎ በመፍረድ የሞት ቅጣት አስተላለፈባቸው። ናጂብ በፍርድ ቤት በአካል የተገኙ ቢሆንም፣ አሰድ እና ወንድማቸው በአሁኑ ጊዜ ሞስኮ ውስጥ ስለሚገኙ በሌሉበት ነው ብይን የተሰጠባቸው። ይህ ውሳኔ የሀገሪቱ የሽግግር መንግስት በቀድሞው አስተዳደር ባለስልጣናት ላይ የወሰደው የመጀመሪያው ታሪካዊ እርምጃ ነው።
oromo: Mana murtii Suuriyaa dura ta'aa biyyattii Bashar al-Asaad, obboleessa isaa Maher fi hoggansaa duraanii Atef Najib irratti himata ajjeechaa fi dararaa raawwataniin du'a murteesseera. Najib mana murtii irratti kan argame yoo ta'u, obboleewwan Asaad garuu ammaan tana magaalaa Moskoo waan jiraniif bakka hin jirretti murtiin kun irratti darbeera. Murtiin seena qabeessi kun mootummaa cehumsaa biyyattiin hoggantoota sirna duraanii irratti tarkaanfii seeraa kan jalqabaa fudhateedha.

title: Two wounded in Israeli drone attack in Lebanon
english: Two civilians were injured in Nabatieh, Lebanon, following a drone strike conducted by Israel. A subsequent attack damaged an ambulance operated by the Al-Risala Association while emergency workers were transporting a victim. The Lebanese health ministry confirmed these incidents occurred on Tuesday.
amharic: በሊባኖስ ናባቲህ ከተማ በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሲቪሎች ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎም የተጎዱ ሰዎችን ለማጓጓዝ የሞከረ የአል-ሪሳላ ማህበር አምቡላንስ ላይ ሌላ ጥቃት ደርሶ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የሊባኖስ የጤና ሚኒስቴር ማክሰኞ ዕለት እንደገለጸው የድንገተኛ አደጋ ሠራተኞች ለተጎጂዎች እርዳታ ለመስጠት ሲሞክሩ ነበር ይህ የተፈጠረው።
oromo: Magaalaa Naabatiye kan Libaanoos keessatti weerara xiyyaara kashilaa (drone) Israa'eliin raawwatameen namoonni nagaa lama madaa'aniiru. Hojjattoonni fayyaa namoota madaa'an wal'aanuuf yeroo gargaarsatti jiranitti, ambulaansii dhaabbata Al-Risaala irra weerarri lammaffaan raawwatamee miidhaan irra ga'eera. Ministeerri fayyaa Libaanoos akka ibsetti, miidhaan kun guyyaa Kibxata darbe akka raawwatame mirkaneesseera.

title: Amhara Nationalism Faces Historic Choice in National Dialogue
english: Ethiopia’s upcoming constitutional reforms are challenging the long-standing assumption that Amhara politics occupies the center of the nation's power structure. The transition from the old coalition-based system to the Prosperity Party's majoritarian model means political influence is now determined by regional population size rather than equal representation. This shift effectively moves Amhara political interests from the core to the periphery, forcing a major reassessment of their traditional role in Ethiopian governance.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የሕገ-መንግስት ማሻሻያ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየውን የአማራ ፖለቲካ በአገሪቱ ማዕከል የመሆን አመለካከት እየፈተነው ነው። አሁን ያለው የብልጽግና ፓርቲ ሥርዓት በሕዝብ ቁጥር ላይ የተመሠረተ የፖለቲካ ውክልናን በመከተሉ፣ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ ከማዕከል ወደ ዳር እየተሸጋገረ ይገኛል። ይህ ለውጥ የአማራ የፖለቲካ ልሂቃን በአገሪቱ አወቃቀር ውስጥ ያላቸውን ባህላዊ ሚና እንደገና እንዲገመግሙ እያስገደዳቸው ነው።
oromo: Fooyya'iinsi seer-bu’uuraa Itoophiyaa kan ammaa kun, siyaasni Amaaraa giddu-galeessa mootummaa Itoophiyaa keessatti bakka guddaa qabaachuu qaba kan jedhu ilaalcha durii irratti dhiibbaa uumee jira. Sirni mootummaa ammaa kan Paartii Badhaadhinaa, dhiibbaa siyaasaa lakkoofsa ummataa irratti kan hundaaye waan ta’eef, gaheen siyaasa Amaaraa giddu-galeessa irraa gara qarqaraatti akka siqu taasisaa jira. Jijjiiramni kun hayyoonni siyaasa Amaaraa gahee isaan Itoophiyaa keessatti qaban irra deebi'anii akka yaadan isaan dirqisiisaa jira.

title: Mass grave with 25 bodies found in Sudan’s Kurmuk after army retakes town
english: Sudanese military forces recently discovered a mass grave containing at least 25 bodies in the town of Kurmuk. Local officials have blamed the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces for these killings, noting that the victims included women, children, and hospital staff. This disturbing find occurred as the army continues to clear the area following their successful recapture of the town from rebel control.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር በኩርሙክ ከተማ ቢያንስ 25 አስከሬኖች የሚገኙበት የጅምላ መቃብር ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። የከተማዋ አስተዳዳሪዎች ግድያው የተፈጸመው በራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርስ አማፂ ቡድን እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ የተገኘው የጅምላ መቃብር የሴቶች፣ የህጻናት እና የሆስፒታል ሰራተኞች አስከሬኖችን እንደያዘ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ግኝት የተመዘገበው ጦሩ ከተማዋን ከተቆጣጠረ በኋላ ባደረገው የፍተሻ ስራ ነው።
oromo: Humnooni waraana Sudaan magaalaa Kurmuk keessatti awwaala faachaa 25 ol qabate tokko argachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Hojjettooni mootummaa naannichaa ajjeechaa kanaaf kan itti gaafatamuu qaban humnoota Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ta'uu ibsanii, awwaalichatti keessatti reeffa dubartoota, ijoollee fi hojjettoota hospitaala akka argaman eeraniiru. Qorannoon kun kan godhame waraanni Sudaan magaalattii to'annoo isaa jala oolchuu isaatiin booda hojii sakatta'iinsa taasifameen dha.

title: Donald Trump says replacing Gianni Infantino would be a ‘terrible mistake’
english: US President Donald Trump has publicly supported FIFA President Gianni Infantino, warning that removing him from office would be a serious error. Infantino is currently facing strong criticism and calls for his resignation from major football confederations following a controversial attempt to privatize parts of the World Cup. Despite this backlash, Trump praised Infantino’s leadership, claiming that his departure would harm the future success and profitability of the organization.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የፊፋው ፕሬዚዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖን በግልጽ በመደገፍ፣ ከኃላፊነታቸው እንዲነሱ ማድረጉ ትልቅ ስህተት እንደሆነ ገለጹ። ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን በከፊል ለግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ባቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ ምክንያት ከበርካታ የዓለም እግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ሆኖም ትራምፕ የኢንፋንቲኖን አመራር በማድነቅ፣ ከስልጣናቸው መውረድ የድርጅቱን ስኬት እና ገቢ ይጎዳል ብለዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp pirezidaantii FIFA Jaanii Infaantiinoo akka deggeran ibsanii, bakka isaanii buusuun dogoggora hamaa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Infaantiinoon erga sagantaa waancaa addunyaa qooda isaa dhuunfaatti gurguruuf yaalanii booda, waldaalee kubbaa miilaa gurguddoo irraa ceephoo cimaa mudataniiru. Kana hunda osoo jiru, Tiraampin hojii Infaantiinoo galateeffachuun, yoo isaan aangoo gadi lisan bu'aan FIFA fi galii inni argatu akka xiqqaatu ibsaniiru.

title: Russian attacks kill six in Ukraine’s Zaporizhzhia
english: A series of Russian missile and drone strikes across Ukraine resulted in at least six deaths and several injuries, including damage to a children's hospital in Kyiv. Regional authorities reported massive destruction in the Zaporizhzhia area, while Ukraine responded with drone attacks in Russia that killed one person. These intensifying military operations highlight an escalation in long-range aerial warfare between the two nations.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ከተሞች በፈጸመችው የሚሳኤልና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስድስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ በርካታ ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ በኪዬቭ የሚገኝ የህፃናት ሆስፒታልን ጨምሮ በዛፖሪዝሂያ አካባቢ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በምላሹ ዩክሬን በሩሲያ የቮሮኔዝ ክልል ባደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ማለፉን የክልሉ አስተዳደር አስታውቋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት እያደረጉት ያለው የአየር ጥቃት በተጠናከረ መልኩ መቀጠሉ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni Raashiyaa magaalota Yukreenii fi naannoo Zaaporizhiiyaatti miiseelaa fi dooniiwwaniin haleellaa raawwateen namoonni ja'a ajjeefamanii, kan biroo hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaa kanaan hospitaalli ijoollee kan Maqdishoo (Kyiv) keessatti argamu miidhaan irra ga'eera. Yukreenis gama ishiitiin naannoo Woroneez kan Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa doonii raawwattee namni tokko yoo du'u, gochi kun wal-waraansa qilleensa irraa kan lamaan gidduutti godhamu daran hammaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Iran to increase gas production, says state minister
english: Iran plans to boost its natural gas output by 95 million cubic metres by late September. This effort follows repair work on energy facilities that were previously damaged by international strikes. The country is working to recover production levels that dropped significantly due to ongoing conflicts.
amharic: ኢራን በሴፕቴምበር ወር መጨረሻ የጋዝ ምርቷን በ95 ሚሊዮን ኪዩቢክ ሜትር ከፍ ለማድረግ አቅዳለች። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ቀደም ሲል በደረሰባቸው ጥቃት ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ከተጠገኑ በኋላ ነው። አገሪቱ በግጭቶች ሳቢያ ቀንሶ የነበረውን የምርት መጠን ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታው ለመመለስ ጥረት እያደረገች ነው።
oromo: Iiraan dhuma ji'a Fulbaanaatti oomisha gaazii ishee meetira kiyuubikii miliyoona 95'n dabaluuf karoorfatteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame bu'uuraalee misoomaa anniisaa miidhaan irra ga'ee ture erga suphaman boodadha. Biyyattiin walitti buiinsa keessa jirtuun oomishni ishee hir'atee ture gara duriitti deebisuuf tattaaffii gochaa jirti.

title: Israel's 'pilot zones' turn Lebanese sovereignty on its head
english: A U.S.-brokered agreement has introduced 'pilot zones' in southern Lebanon, where the Lebanese army is tasked with taking control as Israeli forces withdraw. Critics argue this plan undermines Lebanese sovereignty by allowing Israel to dictate the terms of security in areas it has heavily damaged. The initiative is being widely condemned as a farce, given Israel's history of occupation and the ongoing conflict that has caused massive destruction in the region.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት የተፈረመው ስምምነት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ 'ሙከራ ቀጠናዎችን' በመፍጠር የሊባኖስ ጦር አካባቢውን እንዲቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ዕቅድ ይዟል። ይሁን እንጂ ስምምነቱ እስራኤል በራሷ ፍላጎት የሊባኖስን ሉዓላዊነት እንድትወስን ስለሚፈቅድ የሀገሪቱን ነፃነት የሚጥስ እንደሆነ ተችቷል። እስራኤል ቀደም ሲል በፈጸመችው ወረራ እና አሁን ባደረሰችው ከፍተኛ ውድመት ሳቢያ፣ ይህ ዕቅድ ከእውነታ የራቀ እና ተቀባይነት የሌለው እንደሆነ እየተገለጸ ይገኛል።
oromo: waliigalteen Ameerikaan giddu galeessa taatee mallatteessite, kutaa kibba Libaanoos keessatti 'iddoowwan qormaataa' uumuudhaan waraanni Libaanoos akka to'atu taasiseera. Ta'us, sagantaan kun Israa'el fedhii ishee akka irratti feetuuf karaa banuudhaan bilisummaa biyyattii kan tuqu ta'uun isaa qeeqameera. Israa'el seenaa weeraraa qabduufi miidhaa hamaa geessiste sana ilaaluudhaan, tattaaffiin kun dhugaa irraa fagaatee fi fudhatama kan hin qabne ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Morning update
english: Libya's oil infrastructure faced drone attacks, leading the National Oil Corporation to warn of potential refinery closures if violence persists.
